Card Q&A.q: I use this card’s effect to trash the top 3 cards of my deck. If a yellow or purple Digimon card is among those cards, can I then use this effect to return it from my trash to my hand?

Effect: [Main] Trash the top 3 cards of your deck. Then, if you have a yellow Digimon in play, return 1 yellow or purple Digimon card from your trash to your hand.
